camel_example: aliyun polardb DescribeHistoryTasks --region cn-hangzhou --Status Running --FromStartTime '2025-01-02T11:31:03Z' --TaskId 't-0mqi38ho0cgjv000' --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-000000000000' --InstanceId 'pc-2zed3m89cw000' --ToExecTime 0 --PageNumber 1 --TaskType ChangeVariable --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType Instance --ToStartTime '2025-01-03T11:31:03Z' --FromExecTime 0
description_en: Retrieves a list of historical administrative tasks for PolarDB for MySQL instances, such as parameter changes, and instance restarts
description_zh: PolarDB MySQL 查询历史任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-history-tasks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --instance-type Instance --status Running --instance-id pc-2zed3m89cw000 --task-id t-0mqi38ho0cgjv000 --task-type ChangeVariable --from-start-time 2025-01-02T11:31:03Z --to-start-time 2025-01-03T11:31:03Z --from-exec-time 0 --to-exec-time 0 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHistoryTasks

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看地域信息详情
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：10~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: positive integers. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果的页码。取值范围：正整数。 默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Scheduled: waiting for execution

Running: executing

Succeed: executed successfully

Cancelling: stopping

Canceled: stopped

Waiting: waiting for preset time

You can provide a comma-separated list. Default value: empty, which indicates all statuses
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，取值范围如下：
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间

如需查询多个状态则用英文逗号分隔，默认为空，表示全选
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID to filter by. You can provide a comma-separated list of up to 30 IDs. Default value: empty, indicating no restriction.

Currently, only PolarDB cluster IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。用于查询对应资源的任务，如有多个用英文逗号分隔，最多支持 30 个，默认为空，表示不限制。

目前只支持集群ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can provide a comma-separated list of up to 30 IDs. Default value: empty, indicating no restriction
parameters.help_zh: 任务 ID。如有多个任务 ID，使用英文用逗号分隔，最多支持 30 个，默认为空，表示不限制
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The task type. You can provide a comma-separated list of up to 30 task types. Default value: empty, indicating no restriction
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，用于查询特定类型任务情况，如有多个用英文逗号分隔，最多支持 30 个，默认为空，表示不限制
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query, based on task start time. The time follows the ISO8601 standard and must be in `UTC+0` time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

The earliest supported time is 30 days ago. If the specified time is more than 30 days ago, it will be automatically converted to 30 days ago
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的起始时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之后的任务。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 `UTC+0` 时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。最早支持 30 天前，距当前时间超过 30 天会自动转换成 30 天前
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query, based on task start time. The time follows the ISO8601 standard and must be in `UTC+0` time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的结束时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之前的任务。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用`UTC+0` 时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
parameters.name: to_start_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum task execution time in seconds. Filters for tasks that took longer than this value. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最小值。用于筛选任务执行耗时大于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认 0，表示不限制
parameters.name: from_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum task execution time in seconds. Filters for tasks that took less than this value. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最大值。用于筛选任务执行耗时不小于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认 0，表示不限制
parameters.name: to_exec_time
